title: Skill
description: A skill governed by an attribute, rated 0-100+ as a d100 roll-under percentile

key.description: Symbolic snake_case key (the old string id) for human readability when editing JSON.

label.description: Human-readable display name with spaces and capitalization.

associatedAbility.description: Attribute that seeds this skill's starting rating: base = 2 + attr*2 + Luck/2

category.description: Grouping for character sheets and perk-tree organization

taggable.description: Whether this skill may be chosen as one of the character's starting tag skills (+15 and faster growth). Defaults to true.
